chunks: From him, from ʿAbd Allah ibn Jabalah, from Dharih, from Abi ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام:
That Jibra'il عليه السلام came to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله in the second time for Maghrib, before the twilight disappeared.

key_terms.جَبْرَئِيلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَامُ: the angel Jibra'il, peace be upon him
key_terms.ٱلنَّبِيَّ صَلَّى ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِ: the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family

ai.seo_question: Until when does the time of Maghrib salat remain according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith fragment reports that Jibra'il عليه السلام came to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم concerning the second time of Maghrib before the disappearance of the twilight. It indicates a teaching related to the timing of salat and helps define the valid period for performing Maghrib prayer.
